demands.title: Astra build demand D5 — build demands that survive the conversation. Make the #coordination demand stream usable across sessions: a peer can discover useful unclaimed work, see who is already doing what, contribute, hand it on, and find the actual result later. Reuse existing Commons demand/assignment/job surfaces. Preserve the original request and subsequent owner corrections. Lost or duplicated intent is the real problem.

note: Durable demand pickup/continuation surface. Prose demands keep original + corrections. Multi-claim occupancy is visible; collisions are not silent. Slack CLAIMED alone does not close a demand — result.pointer does. Instrument: host/demand_survive.py. Door: demand-survive.html.
